subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should maintainers treat the merged partial-runtime Feishu fix as sufficient for this specific WebSocket event-delivery report, or require fresh live Feishu proof first?
rationale: The source now contains the adjacent runtime guard and the expected handler wiring, but the reported symptom depends on a live Feishu persistent-connection delivery path that this review could not exercise.

options.title: Run live Feishu QA first
options.body: Use a real Feishu/Lark app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled and capture redacted gateway and SDK logs before deciding whether code still needs a fix.

options.title: Close after maintainer proof override
options.body: Close only if a maintainer with Feishu access confirms that current main/latest release receives message events in the reported setup.

options.title: Fold into broader Feishu inbound tracking
options.body: Link this to the broader Feishu inbound-loss cluster only if live evidence shows the same partial-runtime root cause or another shared failure point.

recommendation.title: Run live Feishu QA first
recommendation.body: Use a real Feishu/Lark app with `im.message.receive_v1` enabled and capture redacted gateway and SDK logs before deciding whether code still needs a fix.
